evidence.mechanism: shot-08s: a vermilion four-armed cross with thin diagonal front lines and umber scars spans the square grid; by shot-20s the fronts merge into an off-centre irregular blob, so the cascade reads but does not branch clearly.
evidence.ambition: shot-08s: one flat 200-cell height field tinted apricot to umber with a live vermilion front; no lighting, material or second layer is visible, so the bytes buy one simulated 2D field rather than several rendering ideas.
evidence.craft: shot-02s: speckled 0-3 tint noise fills the border and a flat vermilion disc covers the centre; at full size the caption at bottom-left is clipped by the grid edge at shot-08s and the cells read as pixel static.
evidence.distinctness: shot-02s: apricot and vermilion sand on a square grid, unlike the rose dendrite of 2026-11-25; the ochre and rust palette still overlaps the 2026-11-23 Penrose kites, so the distinctness is only partial.
evidence.polish: shot-20s: the grid shrinks and the vermilion blob sits off-centre with a stepped edge instead of a centred four-fold umber pile; the 2 s disc and 20 s blob never resolve into one composed end state.

pairwise_justification: Head-to-head, the median's crisp rose dendrite on a dark field reads cleaner than tonight's speckled apricot grid; tonight's 2 s flat disc is weaker than the median's branched tip, though tonight's 8 s X is stronger.

Resolve the 20 s frame: let the cascade die so the vermilion clears and the umber pile re-centres into the four-fold square seen at shot-08s, instead of the off-centre blob at shot-20s.
Remove the speckled 0-3 tint noise on the border and keep the caption fully inside the frame at bottom-left; use one flat umber tone outside the active grid to lift craft.
